title: Colonel Roosevelt’s speech to be delivered at Detroit, Michigan
checks: The document calls this a speech to be delivered. It may have been prepared and never given.
Day by Day, which follows the Theodore Roosevelt Association's Chronological Record, places him at Roosevelt Hospital on this date, about 770 km from Detroit. One of the two dates may be wrong.

trc.title: Colonel Roosevelt’s speech to be delivered at Detroit, Michigan, Feb. 14, 1918
